Read the  
docs<https://c.gle/AKMee0dMhpOitm0dmdtrBIEsekxjPEoL7xwDWr5L5dA62qF9aD9XCosVgyacIfpuwpSjSN8b48Xh1V_kJscLFbS21ZQ4_UAyH8mijlZ08FnX2R95T00-UEYtcbKIgw8Sq8XD-DMKPknCpBxkoPzK19tNo1mUBBX3dGHDZr0Op06mX2rH18Tz>

Hi Linh,

We are excited to share that Gemini 3.6 Flash (gemini-3.6-flash) and Gemini  
3.5 Flash-Lite (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) are now generally available in the  
Gemini API and ready for your production environments.

Gemini 3.6 Flash

17% more token-efficient with better quality and lower cost than Gemini 3.5  
Flash. Optimized for multi-step orchestration, full-stack code generation,  
and general reasoning.

Reduced  
pricing<https://c.gle/AKMee0dbM4JxNJWRqbopMujoG5PxY2zBIC0GcoRhZC_jrGrgHaRaZ2VF1WyFEuzjTJLrJI5Yy1pvwBjX1ED1Bz83UFhofsMTZl4FPqwc_a4OSAr0ASXuWFN0yKOw2ZXLz-s-rBLjO1-Z3FlhBDDii_vMe7vfFRoA0KTmR3Mv26bEN-F6UZ1da2DJBRj-udFbTUA>: Lower  
output token costs ($7.50/1M vs. $9.00/1M for 3.5 Flash), maintaining input  
tokens at $1.50/1M.

Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite

Our fastest and most cost-efficient 3.5 model, designed to scale agentic  
workflows that demand super fast inference.

Get full 'What's New'  
breakdown<https://c.gle/AKMee0fqtmbCoGrvxiW9nrDYaiJgYH1YOLFpxMUQLghPgtzTMJUbVXnnaGCuuk3bwtvU3s6hJ1fwF92XCYvque87qJFJzmCMtq_utMnYjxKeA-tmsdx07d2pJiqhsr03T8jMggzAY9qs1V_GIP9ImrKlqGbxWdjpF3jZQsh7hJ6Gi1VRDN2JDVzlIEB1NQTVAFo>

Abstract dark interface graphic with glowing tiles featuring lock, search,  
settings, document, and cursor  
icons.<https://c.gle/AKMee0cAZ9ArPaR_xVzyNh28ib3UzLaw375Q_az2ypiTHVLP0rKf8UaZi3rHAahzbw2khgAi2iC32Lk8AdxopEdzT_9QfN0aJBRd4aIxhABetlUwU0Gp5ZtddiO0wotJ_WFDhmdcpG_OYpNf7m4DbG_3bZDtEKOAprh5FYl3I0BCL26PxGAEt9VW>

Compare models in the demo app

Built with Gemini managed agents and the latest Flash models in Google AI  
Studio.

Try in the demo  
app<https://c.gle/AKMee0fd7Apb3YCvlWAePuTqFp_nANhepc9I4eQs8z92HhliUPTQGSGcLhwtIp8eaqteQp3bSwGlAD9pSdDkSIVsiUwsGJ4a3LesyOZKEd8UXTroEzQkbHvaPiWokBYjYZfr8J8zTHf6opENTTJge3kdB3ks-0bXWUZSdt6_OszDcraNfY5F>

Start building

You can use our SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and Go, or make a direct REST  
API call with cURL. Get your paid API  
key<https://c.gle/AKMee0fFnfcXIW6RQEdMf9QQKZEAkXU_kLGQr_5Dp88b84yk3uGUrxfuNMaPogAmRR9djvvPcKYU5wRiZ3d88VezpHGItlvCmLUyRi2-OTEevnCZb1Rb6-P4S-rPVZfBuo25PxtViEMzqiH7ag8eZ74s1Q5wg7YL1EhhIz0>  
and start creating.

from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

# Build with Flash

interaction = client.interactions.create(

model="gemini-3.6-flash",

input="Do something cool.",

)

print(interaction.output_text)

# Build with Flash-Lite

interaction = client.interactions.create(

model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite",

input="Do something cool with these 50 items.",

)

print(interaction.output_text)

Documentation

Explore all model features, technical details, and prompting guides.

Read the  
docs<https://c.gle/AKMee0fQBcaf0-KFlNFJ_m2lkrJsFpdfAlJuiw5ZB6J3f1AWx-z_vvP2kB8ZECPgs3b6vIAqZN5KJKxM_WruU2Olk6P-Lutych-8o5ofgAmJvf1n-jZChp8lefF63lWC59-JB4Yio5E8pitdxpBGYuuZWP5d2OxtRNit4vbjlC2bie0mn8RB>

Pricing

Review all pricing tiers, token limits, and detailed API cost breakdowns.

See  
pricing<https://c.gle/AKMee0e6eBnN25joCpH6WYK8fDTwqxMDZAYfs6bg9B71RxBbIWweGEzenZ6rimHkLQ6DRpUYCvEhKNYHIfKlW7odlK0sRwkotSux-WjULxri4PmSK7J9_dhklmiqgmIdcKJJs9ftJnOW52s67VZYfy3RO_nICC6rqYSBI0O29SNaz_C_yQ-G8Z-JXVFMtg>

Also: the n8n MCP creator explains how to use it, and a workflow that automates job searching  

 

( https://n8n.io?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=logo-header )

​

Events ( https://luma.com/n8n-events?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=nav-events )        Forum ( https://community.n8n.io/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=nav-forum )        Docs ( https://docs.n8n.io/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=nav-docs ) 

 

Welcome, friends!
-----------------

I'll keep this intro short, since I'm still recovering from n8n Fest.

I had a great time meeting and speaking to so many of you! We don't take it for granted that hundreds of you came to party with us in Berlin. 

Our first n8n Conference this October will be another chance to gather with the rest of the community and the n8n Team. We have big plans for it: sign up below to be the first to hear the details.

Read on for more exciting stories, from a webinar with the n8n docs team, to a workflow that automates your job search, and a podcast episode with the creator of our MCP server.

Enjoy!

Bart
Community Lead

 

 

 

( https://n8n.io/intheloop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=conference-banner-image )

In The Loop 2026

We’re hosting n8n’s first official conference in Berlin this October.

In The Loop 2026 will bring together builders, customers, and the leaders shaping the future of automation. Hear real production stories, learn how top teams build reliable workflows, celebrate the n8n community, and discover where automation is headed next.

Be among the first to access early-bird tickets.

Sign up now ( https://n8n.io/intheloop/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=conference-cta )

 

 

 

 

 

More From the Community

 

( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_7V-AseDCrc&list=PLlET0GsrLUL5FnLsRCh0BwmQTtv81dk6a&index=32&utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter )

​

n8n Podcast

New episode with the creator of n8n's MCP
-----------------------------------------

Milorad, the creator of the n8n instance-level MCP server, shows you how to get the most out of our MCP, and gives a preview of what's still in development.

Watch now ➔ ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_7V-AseDCrc&list=PLlET0GsrLUL5FnLsRCh0BwmQTtv81dk6a&index=32&utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter )

 

( https://n8n.io/workflows/12014-automate-job-search-and-resume-matching-with-linkedin-gemini-ai-and-google-sheets/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=template-cta )

​

Featured Template

Automate job search & resume matching
-------------------------------------

Find and evaluate job opportunities using LinkedIn, Gemini AI, and Google Sheets, thanks to this workflow by Dinakar Selvakumar ( https://n8n.io/creators/jamesdinakar/ ).

Read more ➔ ( https://n8n.io/workflows/12014-automate-job-search-and-resume-matching-with-linkedin-gemini-ai-and-google-sheets/?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=template-cta )

 

 

 

 

Community Events
----------------

​

View all events ➔ ( https://n8n.io/community/events?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=events-viewall )

 

( https://luma.com/n8n-p7hp?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=meetup-dc-cta )

 

Washington D.C. Meetup
----------------------

23 July, 5.30-8pm local time

Join the first meetup for the DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia community. Discover n8n through a live build, and network with other members interested in AI automation.

Sign up now ( https://luma.com/n8n-p7hp?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=meetup-dc-cta )

Webinar: Automating Documentation
----------------------------------

28 July, 4-5pm GMT+1

Curious how to automate docs updates end-to-end? The n8n docs team and the Gitbook team are are showing how they run an open, community-driven docs workflow.

Register ( https://www.gitbook.com/events/gitbook-n8n?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=webinar-gitbook-cta )

( https://luma.com/n8n-iqll?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=hackathon-cta )

 

Guadalajara Hackathon
---------------------

13 August, 6.30-9.30pm local time

Bring your laptop and friends, and get ready to build together using rapid prototyping and community feedback. And of course, snacks and drinks!

Don't miss out ( https://luma.com/n8n-iqll?utm_source=customerio&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_q3_june_community_newsletter&utm_content=hackathon-cta )
